name: question-panel
description: Docked panel that collects every question Claude asks, lets you answer them at your own pace, and sends all answers in one message.

surfaces.title: Where the Question Panel runs
surfaces.description: "desktop" (default): only in the Claude desktop app; terminal sessions keep the built-in question prompt. "everywhere": also in terminal sessions.

redirectBuiltin.title: Send Claude's built-in questions to the panel
redirectBuiltin.description: On (default): when Claude asks with the built-in question prompt (AskUserQuestion), the questions go to the panel instead. Off: the built-in dialog shows as usual. /questions on and /questions off change this.
